title: Arvin Road, Crossing Without a Crosswalk, & Yearly Passes at Fairlawn
description: Settling into the brick ranch on Arvin Road as unofficial homeowners, Katie and Nate sleep skin to skin in their bedroom closet while leaving the queen bed untouched, brave the crosswalk-free traffic of Indian River Road and Military Highway for groceries at Market Square, rebuild their transit blog in PHP with Tina, Sheila, and Jim, and ride CVTA Routes 15 and 25 to get yearly memberships at the 1977 Fairlawn Recreation Center.
